Type I: This type of collagen makes up 80 to 90% of your body’s total collagen. Because it is densely packed, type I collagen provides structure to skin, bones, tendons, and ligaments.
Type II: Found in elastic cartilage, such as knees and shoulders, this type of collagen provides support for joints.
Type III: This type of collagen is commonly present with Type I and is found in muscles, arteries, and organs.
